title: Saturnine
summary: SAT'URNINE, adjective [Latin Saturnus.] 1. Supposed to be under the influence of Saturn. Hence, 2. Dull; heavy; grave; not readily susceptible of excitement; phlegmatic; as a saturnine person or tempe
